description: This is a test class for the AnySoftKeyboardMediaInsertion component, containing unit tests for media insertion functionality, media type handling, and remote insertion interactions within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardMediaInsertionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing media insertion features in AnySoftKeyboard, including media type support, remote request handling, and UI interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, mocks remote insertion, and verifies mock setup.

methods.name: testReportsMediaTypesAndClearsOnFinish
methods.description: Tests that media types are correctly reported and cleared after input flow.

methods.name: testMediaTypesIsUnmodifiable
methods.description: Ensures that the supported media types list is unmodifiable.

methods.name: testCallsRemoteInsertionWithCorrectArguments
methods.description: Verifies that remote insertion is called with correct arguments when media popup is triggered.

methods.name: testDoesNotCommitIfInputFieldIsDifferent
methods.description: Checks that media is not committed if the input field has changed.

methods.name: testQueueImageInsertionTillTargetTextBoxEntered
methods.description: Tests queuing of image insertion until the user enters the target text box.

methods.name: testDestroyRemoteOnServiceDestroy
methods.description: Verifies remote insertion is destroyed when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: testCommitsIfInputFieldIsSame
methods.description: Checks that media is committed if the input field remains the same.

methods.name: testDoesNotCommitIfRequestCancelled
methods.description: Ensures media is not committed if the request is cancelled.
